items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Keep security-sensitive releases, new public exposure, and gated-product launches blocked pending direct control evidence; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: fleet-doctor unavailable (ok=false, last_run=null); operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS has no recorded expirations within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is unknown. Compliance is mixed at 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Severity: high for release-clearance uncertainty, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: retain containment-only security controls and continue the existing read-only evidence matrix; do not certify, deploy security-sensitive changes, expose gated products, retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions, add dependencies, or request duplicate telemetry.

Security handoff: continue only the existing fleet security evidence work. Required evidence remains dated, authorized records for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure and handling, container/runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS configuration and coverage, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Preserve unknowns; missing evidence is not evidence of a vulnerability or a clean bill of health.
